skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints
skill.summary: Execute written implementation plans in small batches with verification and review checkpoints.
skill.author: obra

security_audit.summary: I reviewed SKILL.md, the only scanned file, and found prompt-only workflow instructions. Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns, and I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or business-logic abuse.

content.value_statement: Implementation plans can lose focus when work moves into a separate AI session. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through batch execution, verification, and review checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Loads a written implementation plan before starting work.
Reviews the plan for unclear steps, missing dependencies, or critical gaps.
Executes the first three tasks by default, then pauses for review.
Runs requested verification steps and reports their output.
Stops and asks for help when blockers or repeated failures occur.
limitations: It does not create the implementation plan for the user.
It depends on the plan to define tasks, verification commands, and scope.
It may pause often because review checkpoints are part of the workflow.
It references another finishing skill that may not exist in every environment.

use_cases.title: Engineering Lead Handoff
use_cases.description: Use it to help an assistant execute an approved technical plan in small, reviewable batches.

use_cases.title: Solo Developer Execution
use_cases.description: Use it to keep implementation focused when returning to a plan in a new session.

use_cases.title: Reviewer-Controlled Delivery
use_cases.description: Use it when a reviewer wants progress reports and verification output before more tasks proceed.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans workflow on docs/implementation-plan.md. Review the plan first, then complete the first batch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner start for a clear existing plan.

prompt_templates.title: Execute With Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Follow the plan in PLAN.md. Stop before work if any task lacks verification, dependencies, or ownership.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the plan needs careful validation before coding.

prompt_templates.title: Continue After Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue executing the next batch from the existing plan. Apply my feedback first, then report implemented changes and verification results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after reviewing a completed batch.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Final Completion
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute the remaining plan batches with review checkpoints. When all tasks pass verification, transition to the finishing branch workflow.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use for finishing a longer implementation.

output_examples.input: Run the first batch from the migration plan.
output: Plan reviewed. No blockers found before execution.
Completed tasks 1 through 3 and ran the requested checks.
Applied the requested changes before starting the next batch.
Completed the next planned tasks and captured verification results.
Paused for review before further work.

best_practices: Provide the plan file path and expected verification steps at the start.
Keep each plan task small enough for one focused implementation pass.
Review reports before asking the assistant to continue with the next batch.
anti_patterns: Do not use it with vague plans that lack tasks or success checks.
Do not ask it to skip verification when the plan requires checks.
Do not use it for urgent one-step fixes that do not need checkpoints.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant execute a written implementation plan in batches with review checkpoints.

faq.question: Does it write the plan for me?
faq.answer: No. It expects an existing plan and focuses on execution, verification, and reporting.

faq.question: How many tasks does it run at once?
faq.answer: The default batch is the first three tasks, followed by a report and review pause.

faq.question: When will it stop and ask for help?
faq.answer: It stops for missing dependencies, unclear instructions, repeated verification failures, or critical plan gaps.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The scanned skill file contains only workflow instructions.
